title: Rattle Tooth's Kinfolk
description: Rattle Tooth's Kinfolk — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Eliminate the first part of Rattle Tooth's Family. Report your progress to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Rattle Tooth's Extended Kinfolk

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Eliminate the first part of Rattle Tooth's Family. Report your progress to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

The longer it takes for you to take out Rattle Tooth's Family, the higher the bounty for you climbs. Already you are little more than a sack of money with arms and legs. I highly suggest getting down into Algernon and removing some of the incentives that are being offered to take you out.

It seems the biggest financiers are Rattle Tooth's Brothers and Sister: Rattle Eye, Rattle Neck and Rattle Ear. They can be found wandering on Levels 2, 4 and 6 of Algernon. Take them out, and then update the Townston Commander of your progress - that would be me!

Turn-in:

Well this is certainly a start. Your value has decreased, at least temporarily. Although with today's exchange rates, you would still bring in a tidy sum. Hmm, take this 'reward' in case you need to pay anyone off. You might want to consider taking out a bit more of the Family to be sure.

Objectives:

  • Eliminate Rattle Eye
  • Eliminate Rattle Neck
  • Eliminate Rattle Ear

Level range: 4–100
